name: Tyler, the Creator
description: A recurring mix of preppy golf-course references, varsity knitwear, and playful vintage color, worn with confident, boxy proportions.
layeringRules: crewneck sweater over a collared shirt
outerwear worn open rather than zipped
recurringStylePrinciples: mixes preppy tailoring with playful, saturated color
elevates golf and varsity references instead of logos
prioritizes texture over branding
boxy on top, fuller through the leg

name: Zendaya
description: Sharp, architectural tailoring built around a single, committed color story per look, balancing red-carpet drama with clean lines.
layeringRules: blazer worn as the statement piece, often with nothing competing underneath
recurringStylePrinciples: commits fully to one color story per look
pairs tailoring with red-carpet drama rather than separating the two
lets silhouette do the talking before pattern or print
polished, considered finishing on every hem and seam

name: A$AP Rocky
description: High-low layering that puts vintage workwear next to designer pieces, in oversized proportions with heavy texture play.
layeringRules: multiple jackets or vests layered together
mixed, contrasting textures in one look
recurringStylePrinciples: high-low mixing of vintage and designer pieces
oversized proportions throughout
heavy texture layering over pattern matching
unexpected accessory placement (chains, beanies) as the finishing note

name: Timothée Chalamet
description: Androgynous, fitted tailoring that plays sheer or textured fabrics against structure, worn with quiet confidence.
layeringRules: tailored jacket worn with nothing underneath for contrast
recurringStylePrinciples: plays with androgynous silhouettes
contrasts sheer or soft texture against structure
keeps everything fitted from the waist down
off-carpet looks stay simple and quiet by comparison

name: Princess Diana
description: Approachable elegance built from mixing relaxed sportswear with tailoring — an oversized knit over a fitted skirt, sneakers under a blazer.
layeringRules: oversized knit layered over a collared shirt
recurringStylePrinciples: mixes casual sportswear with formal tailoring in the same look
oversized on top, fitted through the leg
sneakers used deliberately against dressier pieces
approachable rather than untouchable elegance

name: Steve Jobs
description: A deliberate personal uniform — the same silhouette repeated daily instead of variety, prized for consistency over trend.
recurringStylePrinciples: a personal uniform repeated daily rather than a rotating wardrobe
an extremely narrow, near-monochrome palette
utility valued over trend
the consistency itself is the signature, not any single item

name: James Bond
description: Precision tailoring in a restrained navy-and-charcoal palette — formalwear built for movement, never flash.
layeringRules: shirt and tie under a structured jacket, waistcoat for eveningwear

a deliberately restrained color palette
formalwear cut for movement with softer, unstructured shoulders
confidence communicated through fit, never logos

name: Bruce Wayne
description: Dark, bespoke tailoring with almost no ornamentation — authority projected through structure and restraint.
layeringRules: overcoat worn over a full suit
recurringStylePrinciples: restraint and precision above all
a near-total dark monochrome palette
structured shoulders used to project authority
understated luxury over any visible branding

name: Tony Stark
description: Smart-casual with an edge — a fitted blazer thrown over a graphic tee, tailored trousers, and a confident accent color.
silhouettes: fitted blazer over a fitted tee
layeringRules: blazer worn open over a tee, never buttoned
recurringStylePrinciples: mixes tailoring with casual basics rather than choosing one register
the blazer-over-tee formula as a repeatable signature
one confident accent color per look
smart-casual with a deliberate edge

name: Wednesday Addams
description: Strict monochrome gothic-prep — sharp collars and structured silhouettes with almost no accessories.
accessories: none — braided hair is the signature detail
layeringRules: cardigan layered over a collared blouse
recurringStylePrinciples: an unbroken black-and-white palette
sharp, structured collars
a prep-school silhouette subverted with a gothic mood
minimal accessories so the silhouette does the work

name: Miles Morales
sourceWork: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse / Across the Spider-Verse
description: NYC streetwear with bold color-blocking — a bomber over a graphic hoodie, sneakers as the focal point.
silhouettes: relaxed hoodie with a tapered jogger or jean

relaxed streetwear silhouette top to bottom
sneakers treated as the focal point of the look
everyday NYC energy over anything precious

name: Don Draper
description: Mid-century tailoring precision — grey flannel suiting, a narrow tie, and total sobriety in the palette.
layeringRules: waistcoat under the jacket for formal occasions
recurringStylePrinciples: mid-century tailoring precision
a narrow, disciplined silhouette
monochrome sobriety over pattern or color
confidence communicated through fit and restraint, not flash
